object.description: Give a repository's text markup: an attribute value holding an image tag that names a picture file and a bold tag, a description, an attribute's label, a link type and a filter name holding bold tags, on a branch whose name holds an HTML entity. Open a Document Editor read-only with the object selected in the Inspector, choose the filter, switch to editing, then open Document Properties, the trace view, View at this commit and the Commit dialog; separately show message boxes and an input prompt whose text holds markup. Expected: every label, row label, tooltip, message and prompt shows the text as written, tags included; the Inspector's label for the image value has the size of its text, not of the picture, so the picture file isn't opened; text without markup shows unchanged.
